title: Treated-serum cases defer bounded preparation curation after primary evidence establishes species and heat schedule

decision.reasoning: MediaDive 1895 identifies heat-inactivated human serum as a distinct input alongside MKP medium and bovine serum albumin. The species is human, and heat treatment is explicit; bovine, horse, and generic untreated serum are not interchangeable owners. The primary MediaDive recipe attribute specifies 56°C for 30 min. Donor population and supplier are not specified.
decision.applicability: Reviewed this exact case 'human serum, heat-inactivated', its 1 frozen occurrence(s), and each enclosing recipe at the listed component/stock path. Primary evidence is attached only for the source recipes, definitions and processing contrasts relevant to this case. Retain the human heat-inactivated preparation with its exact occurrence; supplier/donor pooling are needed for a more specific product identity.
decision.no_change_reason: No MIM owner mutation is justified by this bounded source review. Retain the human heat-inactivated preparation with its exact occurrence; supplier/donor pooling are needed for a more specific product identity.
decision.missing_requirement: Retain the human heat-inactivated preparation with its exact occurrence; supplier/donor pooling are needed for a more specific product identity.

existing_independent_case_assessments.assessment: MediaDive1895 explicitly specifies56C30min. Author corrected the initially missed schedule; donor/supplier scope remains open without discarding known treatment.
JCM144/M135 prescribe rabbit serum56C1hour as a post-autoclave filtered addition. It is not the30minute case and source ml is not grams.
JCM946/M993 explicitly provide56C30min and50ml filtered rabbit serum. HTML degree entity is cosmetic while treatment duration is material.

verified_primary_claims.6: MediaDive1895 recipe has solution6640 human serum, heat-inactivated, attribute56C;30min,100ml.
verified_primary_claims.25: JCM144 and TOGOM135 explicitly name rabbit serum heat-inactivated56C1hr,2ml.
verified_primary_claims.40: JCM946 and TOGOM993 explicitly name rabbit serum56C30min,50ml; JCM text says filter-sterilized ahead of addition.

why_defect: Cases declare complete with no proposal and empty owner_records. Case6 defers for supplier/donor detail needed only for a MORE specific product. Cases25/40 defer for receiving-medium quantity normalization. None explains a missing scientific fact preventing a source-qualified preparation or supported supplied-form proposal. Such lookup and bounded curation are within the campaign assignment; not all requested scientific work is complete merely because a generic-parent alias would be unsafe.
remedy: Reassess all no-proposal cases; complete exact owner lookup and evidence-supported bounded proposals, or document the particular unresolved scientific fact and searches preventing them. Keep processing differences and source membership, no guessed supplier/product equivalence, component quantities, global aliases or release approval. Preserve historical assessments and independently review successor payloads.
not_asserted: No equivalence of human/rabbit serums or30/60minute treatments
No approval of existing owner aliases, roles or export
No mandate to repair CultureMech quantities in MIM
scope_limit: All144 no-proposal requirements read; actual primary capture verification for these3 examples only. Broader per-case scientific reassessment and operator work remain separate.
